notes: Ограниченная позиция, реконструируемая по §21: критика самопричинения не ведёт к принятию механистически несвободной воли. Область реконструкции — этот двойной отказ.
preferred_label: Критика метафизической свободы и её механистического обращения — JGB 21

semantic_content.stance_account: Reject the metaphysical self-origination demand while also refusing to substitute a reified mechanistic opposite. The reconstruction concerns this passage’s double refusal.

semantic_scope.identity_criterion: Identity follows this bounded double refusal; a different stance or comprehensive theory has a separate referent.
semantic_scope.scope_note: The two critical moves within JGB 21, without a claim about Nietzsche's complete or unchanging position.

variant_labels.value: Critique of metaphysical freedom and its mechanistic reversal — JGB 21
